independence: The same separate reviewer assessed this fresh responding context. The responding agent did not receive the hidden rubric or prior responses.
method: Assess actual response strings against the unchanged cutoff-boundary rubric and saved revised policy. The initial 8-case run and its failure remain separate and unchanged.
limitations: Only the previously failed two-turn cutoff case was rerun under the revised policy.
This fresh-context success does not establish that the other seven cases pass under the revised policy.
Scripted user replies and agent assessment do not establish human comprehension.
A single focused success does not establish universal reliability or measured improvement.
Decision_state metadata is supplementary. An empty unresolved list covers the exercised fixture decisions, not all requirements of a complete step.

evidence.reason: Simply confirms the selected meaning without unnecessary new choices.

evidence.quote: including 2 keeps [2, 3] and counts two observations. Excluding 2 keeps only [3] and counts one observation.
evidence.reason: The same input shows the one-observation difference.
Confirms both sides of the approved boundary.

evidence.reason: Grounds a recommendation in the stated goal and explicitly identifies its interpretation. It does not claim a scientific convention proves the user's intent; the question still seeks the user's selection.
